content.text: You're connected. Let me sync the spec I found at specs/feature.md into Squire Docs.

content.content: Recipe returned. Set FILE= and run the command once within 5 minutes; it claims a token, imports over REST, and writes the receipt (docGuid deadbeef-1234-4a5b-8c9d-000000000000) back.

input.command: FILE=specs/feature.md; set -e; curl -sf -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat ~/.squire/token)" -H "Content-Type: text/markdown" --data-binary @"$FILE" "http://localhost:3001/api/docs/import?frontmatter=true" -o "$RESP" || { echo "import failed:"; cat "$RESP"; exit 1; }

content.text:
